product_metadata.title: Turquoize Stretch Seat Cushion Cover Sofa Cushion Cover/Spandex Elastic Furniture Protector for Sofa Seat Jacquard Small Checked Sofa Slipcover with Elastic Bottom, Loveseat Cushion Cover, Taupe
features: PERFECT FIT: Our jacquard cushion cover are stretchy to fit regular square seat cushions and also T-cushions. Moreover, elastic cord sewn on bottom give the sofa/ furniture a whole protection. 3 size available: Chair cushion width from 21.6" to 29.5"; Loveseat cushion width from 43.2" to 59"; Sofa cushion width from 64.8" to 88.5";

FUNCTIONAL: Seat Cushion is frequently seated by people or pet, which is easy to get dirty. Having a cushion cover not only protects your furniture from daily tear, spills, stains and so on, but also gives your sofa a new look. Easy Instillation and machine washable

AMAZING MATERIAL: Turquoize's cushion covers are made of 85% polyester/15% spandex fabric with small checks jacquard pattern. High elasticity, soft and anti-wrinkle, durable and long lasting, freshen up your interior decor

METICULOUSLY ENGINEERED: Turquoize's cushion covers fit for most of home furniture. By covering your cushion separately, not only can tuck the extra fabric under the cushion, but also the bouncing back problem is definitely solved. Moreover, relieve your housework to just wash the cushion cover frequently

EASY CARE: Machine washable in cold water. Wash separately at gentle cycle. Using mild laundry detergent. Do not bleach. Turquoize is manufacturing a full range of sofa covers, kindly browse our more luxury sofa slipcovers
